messages.content: Baltimore host finally came through. Wednesday access is 5:00 to 6:30, they have a secure closet for my demo materials, and Friday may run to 4:15. Can we stop holding and book the Wednesday outbound with the Saturday afternoon return?

Yes. With that Friday end time, the Saturday return is the cleaner choice. I still have the Wednesday 10:35 a.m. TPA-BWI nonstop arriving 12:45 p.m., and the Saturday 1:35 p.m. BWI-TPA nonstop arriving about 3:58 p.m. The suite hotel is still available for Aug 14-17 in a queen studio.
Good. What's the rental car versus rideshare math now?

They are close enough that the practical side matters more than the last few dollars. Rideshares look like about $175-$205 total if surge stays normal: airport, hotel, hospital round trips, grocery detour, and back to BWI. A compact rental is about $188 with taxes, plus the hotel parking fee around $24 per night, so roughly $260 before any hospital parking. The rental costs more, but it makes the grocery stop, morning commute, and equipment movement easier.
Let's do the compact. I don't want to be waiting on cars at 7 in the morning with a bag of demo gear.

That makes sense for this one. Before I book, caveats plainly: the airline fare is main cabin, seat selection included, but nonrefundable to cash after the 24-hour rule; future credit would apply if you cancel later. The suite hotel has free cancellation until Aug 12 at 6 p.m.; after that, one night is charged. The hotel has no hot tub, and parking is extra. The car is pay-later and cancelable before pickup.
That works. Does the suite still clearly show the queen setup and fridge/coffee? I don't want a weird room before an early teaching day.

Yes. The room description and hotel confirmation line both show queen studio, in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, desk/work area, fitness room, and indoor pool. Missing item is still the hot tub. The reviews are stronger than the hospital-rate hotel, and the room setup is much clearer.
Okay. Book flights, hotel, and compact car. Window seats if there are decent ones.

Ready to place them at these totals: flights $316.40 round trip, hotel $584.73 including taxes before parking, and compact rental $188.12 pay-later. I have window seats showing on both flight legs. Use the saved card ending 8842?
Yes, use that card. Send me the confirmations and anything I still need to watch.

Booked. Flights: confirmation BWI6KQ, Wed Aug 14 TPA-BWI 10:35 a.m.-12:45 p.m., seat 14A; Sat Aug 17 BWI-TPA 1:35 p.m.-3:58 p.m., seat 16F. Hotel: confirmation HSB-81473, queen studio Aug 14-17, free cancel until Aug 12 at 6 p.m.; coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool confirmed; no hot tub; parking about $24/night. Rental car: confirmation RC9-42B, compact at BWI, pickup Wednesday after arrival and return Saturday before the afternoon flight. Remaining watch items: exact visitor entrance, badge pickup timing, and whether Friday pack-up still fits after a possible 4:15 dismissal.

messages.content: Baltimore sent a revised campus map. The visitor entrance is on the opposite side of the rehab wing from the main garage. Can you clean up the timing so I don't arrive annoyed on Wednesday or late Thursday?

Use the rehab visitor entrance as the target, not the main garage. Wednesday: land 12:45, get the rental by about 1:25, make a light grocery stop around 2:00, check in or drop bags by 2:45, then leave the hotel at 4:15 for the 5:00 setup window. If traffic is heavy, skip unpacking and go hotel desk drop-off only.
Grocery stop before hotel is better? I just need yogurt, seltzer, and a couple of snacks.

Yes, before the hotel. It keeps Wednesday evening open and lets the mini-fridge do its job right away. Keep it to a 15-minute stop near the airport-to-hotel route; if rental pickup runs past 1:45, buy only the cold items and move on.
What time should I leave Thursday and Friday morning?

Thursday: leave the hotel at 6:45 for a 7:20-7:25 arrival, badge pickup, and room settle-in. Friday: leave at 6:40 because you may be carrying more and the dismissal could run late, so you do not want a messy start. Park for the rehab entrance first; use the main garage only as the backup.
Hotel reconfirmed the room, right? I saw something about the pool closing.

Reconfirmed: queen room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and pool access. The pool closes early Thursday for maintenance, so treat Wednesday or Friday as the only realistic pool options. Still no hot tub at this property.
And Saturday checkout with the 1:35 flight?

Pack most of it Friday night after equipment is back in the car. Saturday: breakfast and final pack, check out by 10:30, leave the hotel by 10:45, quick fuel stop if needed, rental return at BWI around 11:25, and be inside the terminal by 11:45 for the unchanged 1:35 p.m. return. That leaves cushion without turning the morning into a scramble.

messages.content: Baltimore is behind me. Indianapolis just sent the pediatric rehab summit schedule. I have a Friday breakout and a Saturday lab, and the hotel block deadline is coming up. Can you compare the official block against the suite hotel and look at Thursday/Sunday flights from Tampa?
Yes. Send me the exact dates and the presenter windows so I can judge whether Thursday arrival and Sunday return are actually comfortable.

October 10 to 13. Presenter check-in is Thursday 3 to 6. Friday breakout is late morning. Saturday lab is 1 to 4, with teardown listed from 4 to 5. I may skip the evening networking unless it is actually expected.

Here is the practical split. The official conference hotel is the easiest: attached to the meeting space, about $239 before tax in the block, customer rating around 4.2, and best if you need to run back to the room between sessions. Caveats: the standard room listing does not clearly confirm a mini-fridge, the fitness room is described as small, and the cancellation terms are not obvious until the booking review screen. The suite hotel is the better room setup: about $214 before tax, queen studio availability, coffee maker, mini-fridge, larger work area, fitness access, and stronger reviews around 4.5. Caveats: no pool, no hot tub, and it is a 12- to 14-minute walk or short rideshare to the convention area.
That's the trade-off I needed. I don't want to save $25 and end up with no fridge or a cramped room. How annoying is the walk in October?

Not terrible in normal weather: flat downtown walk, roughly 0.6 miles. It is fine for a morning start with a laptop bag. After the Saturday lab, or if you have equipment or rain, I would use a rideshare. The official hotel wins if you expect multiple room-to-session trips each day.
Look at flights too. Please don't put me on a Sunday morning return unless everything else is awful.

Thursday options from TPA to IND: most practical is 8:15 a.m. via Atlanta, arriving 12:25 p.m., about $318, which leaves plenty of time for hotel drop and 3-6 presenter check-in. Cheapest is 11:05 a.m. via Charlotte, arriving 3:55 p.m., about $276, but that is too tight if there is any delay. Earliest is 6:20 a.m. via Atlanta, arriving 10:50 a.m., about $386, useful only if you want extra setup time. Sunday returns: best fit is 1:55 p.m. via Charlotte, arriving Tampa 6:32 p.m.; backup is 3:20 p.m. via Atlanta, arriving 8:05 p.m.; the later 5:40 p.m. option gets home after 11 and seems unnecessary.
The 8:15 Thursday and 1:55 Sunday sound right, but don't ticket yet. What do we need to confirm on the official block?

For the official hotel: cancellation deadline, whether the one-night deposit is refundable, whether standard rooms have a mini-fridge and coffee maker, exact bed type, fitness room hours, whether any pool or hot tub access exists, luggage storage on Sunday, and skywalk or meeting-room access hours. The fridge and cancellation terms are the two I would not gloss over.
And conference logistics? The Saturday lab could be the thing that messes up the whole plan.

Ask the conference team: exact presenter check-in location and latest Thursday check-in time, whether Friday breakout presenters need a separate AV check, where Saturday lab materials are stored before and after the lab, whether teardown really ends by 5, who signs off on lab room clearance, and whether Saturday evening networking is required for presenters or just optional.
The suite missing pool and hot tub is not ideal, but for this summit the fridge and workspace matter more. Are the ratings meaningfully different?

Yes, but not night-and-day. The suite hotel has the stronger customer feedback: about 4.5 on Google and frequent comments about clean rooms and useful kitchenettes. The official hotel is still solid at about 4.2, but recent comments mention older standard rooms and elevator waits during large events. Neither looks like a bad hotel; the suite is just clearer on room comfort.
If we hold both, what room types are available?

The suite hotel has a queen studio with coffee maker, mini-fridge, microwave, desk, and fitness access. The official block shows standard king or two doubles; I do not see a queen option in the block, and the fridge is still not stated. If you want one room held at each, I would use queen studio at the suite and standard king at the official hotel unless you prefer two doubles.
Queen studio at the suite. King at the official is fine before two doubles. Can you check the terms without committing if it's nonrefundable?
Yes. I can advance to the review screen for both. I will not submit the card if either one is nonrefundable or has a penalty that is not clearly disclosed before booking.
Do that.

Review terms are workable. Official block: one-night deposit charged now, refundable if canceled by Sept 19 at 5 p.m.; after that, the deposit is forfeited. Suite hotel: pay at property, free cancellation until Oct 8 at 6 p.m. Both allow a card-backed reservation now.
Hold both then. No flights until we get the presenter check-in and teardown answers.

Done. Official conference hotel confirmation IND-BLOCK-7421: standard king, Oct 10-13, one-night deposit refundable until Sept 19 at 5 p.m.; mini-fridge and coffee maker still need confirmation, fitness room is small, pool/hot tub not clearly listed. Suite hotel confirmation IND-SUITE-3186: queen studio, Oct 10-13, pay at property, cancel by Oct 8 at 6 p.m.; coffee maker, mini-fridge, workspace, and fitness access confirmed; no pool or hot tub, longer walk or short rideshare. Flights are not booked. Lead air plan remains Thursday 8:15 a.m. TPA-IND via Atlanta arriving 12:25 p.m., and Sunday 1:55 p.m. IND-TPA via Charlotte arriving 6:32 p.m. Open questions: official room fridge/coffee, Thursday presenter check-in details, Saturday lab storage and teardown, and whether Saturday evening networking is optional.
